5ffa4bb27e90d850a51d.en: Food gives your body energy and helps it grow and stay healthy. Different foods do different jobs.
5ffa4bb27e90d850a51d.id: Makanan memberi tubuhmu energi serta membantunya tumbuh dan tetap sehat. Makanan yang berbeda punya tugas yang berbeda.

dd984016d29d0fe56f50.en: Carbohydrates, like rice, bread and noodles, give you energy.
dd984016d29d0fe56f50.id: Karbohidrat, seperti nasi, roti, dan mi, memberimu energi.

c49dcc7a4c9b39038b3b.en: Proteins, like fish, eggs, tempeh and tofu, help your body grow and repair.
c49dcc7a4c9b39038b3b.id: Protein, seperti ikan, telur, tempe, dan tahu, membantu tubuhmu tumbuh dan memperbaiki diri.

c1b24542cdc6c6fbf861.en: Fruit and vegetables give vitamins, minerals and fibre. These keep you healthy and help food move through your gut.
c1b24542cdc6c6fbf861.id: Buah dan sayur memberi vitamin, mineral, dan serat. Semua itu menjaga kamu tetap sehat dan membantu makanan bergerak melalui ususmu.

695cf8b4ec8d23788133.en: Fats, like oil and butter, store energy and keep you warm. We need only small amounts.

a8af09f58b39db1a9231.en: A balanced meal mixes foods from different groups. Drink water every day too.
a8af09f58b39db1a9231.id: Makanan seimbang memadukan makanan dari kelompok yang berbeda. Minum air juga setiap hari.

bd689d781e73c2f3a20f.en: Fish, eggs and tempeh are rich in protein, which helps the body grow and repair.

7cd1c66373a1e460fc51.id: Nasi, roti, dan mi kaya akan karbohidrat (carbohydrates). Karbohidrat memberi tubuhmu energi.

573a5a7481c572908985.en: Proteins come from foods like fish, eggs and tempeh.
573a5a7481c572908985.id: Protein berasal dari makanan seperti ikan, telur, dan tempe.

5a343e4c0d4c40dca947.en: Vitamins come mostly from fruit and vegetables.

b9d064139fb9927c7dda.en: Fats come from foods like oil and butter.
b9d064139fb9927c7dda.id: Lemak (fats) berasal dari makanan seperti minyak dan mentega.

edcfc3e350c13447fa83.en: Rice, bread and potatoes are carbohydrates. Eggs, tempeh and fish are proteins, and spinach, oranges and papaya give vitamins and minerals.
edcfc3e350c13447fa83.id: Nasi, roti, dan kentang termasuk karbohidrat. Telur, tempe, dan ikan termasuk protein, sedangkan bayam, jeruk, dan pepaya memberi vitamin dan mineral.

5981a6880ea0b8b241e4.en: Carbohydrates give energy and proteins help you grow and repair. Fats store energy, vitamins and minerals keep you healthy, and fibre helps food move through your gut.
5981a6880ea0b8b241e4.id: Karbohidrat memberi energi dan protein membantu tubuhmu tumbuh dan memperbaiki diri. Lemak menyimpan energi, vitamin dan mineral menjaga kamu tetap sehat, dan serat membantu makanan bergerak melalui ususmu.

59b77098ff2d397c145e.en: Tempeh is made from soya beans and has lots of protein. Protein helps your body grow and repair itself.
59b77098ff2d397c145e.id: Tempe terbuat dari kedelai dan punya banyak protein. Protein membantu tubuhmu tumbuh dan memperbaiki diri.

a93710bb76f7ea7f2eec.en: Rice is mostly carbohydrate, for energy.
a93710bb76f7ea7f2eec.id: Nasi sebagian besar berisi karbohidrat, untuk energi.

1fcbceb6b1802b0e13da.en: Cucumber is mostly water, with a few vitamins.
1fcbceb6b1802b0e13da.id: Mentimun (cucumber) sebagian besar berisi air, dengan sedikit vitamin.

f05823b663721780ccd7.en: Sugar is a carbohydrate that gives quick energy.
f05823b663721780ccd7.id: Gula adalah karbohidrat yang memberi energi cepat.

3502a49af06f5e51e2c2.en: Milk contains calcium. Calcium helps build strong bones and teeth.

c9b88830d0574a4cd9f1.en: Iron helps your blood carry oxygen.

a1e63d7e75c60d810e35.en: Sugar gives energy. It does not build bones.
a1e63d7e75c60d810e35.id: Gula memberi energi. Gula tidak membangun tulang.

42bf513d54d22f93eb69.en: Vitamin C helps you heal and fight illness. It is not a mineral.

925ef0c2a03c68b8ff71.en: Fibre comes from plant foods. Brown rice and beans have lots of fibre, which helps food move through your gut.
925ef0c2a03c68b8ff71.id: Serat (fibre) ada pada makanan dari tumbuhan. Nasi merah dan kacang-kacangan punya banyak serat, yang membantu makanan bergerak melalui ususmu.

e3f93c431a628b70eff2.en: Butter is mostly fat. It has no fibre.
e3f93c431a628b70eff2.id: Mentega (butter) sebagian besar berisi lemak. Mentega tidak punya serat.

b682da10b9280bbb16f0.en: Eggs have lots of protein but no fibre.

fb14469e184de7028d85.en: Milk has calcium and protein but no fibre.
fb14469e184de7028d85.id: Susu punya kalsium dan protein, tetapi tidak punya serat.

6d329d8151629766a4ed.id: Makanan Dimas punya karbohidrat, protein, dan sedikit lemak. Dia tidak makan buah atau sayur, jadi makanannya kurang vitamin, mineral, dan serat.

be8f912a0fb1e1781cf3.en: The chicken and tempeh give lots of protein.

2cc31345a611612e53bc.en: These are all mainly carbohydrates. There is no protein food or vegetable.
